result.instructions: Tools for CloudSign, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Create a draft contract, add a PDF and a signer, then send it for signature."; "Which of our documents are still waiting for the other party?"; "Show every document that was concluded last month.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes CloudSign data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run cloudsign_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run cloudsign_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run cloudsign_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. cloudsign_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: cloudsign_list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List the team's documents with their status: 0 draft, 1 waiting for recipients, 2 concluded, 3 cancelled or declined, 4 template. Paged, 100 per page. GET /documents.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (up to 100 items per page).

status.description: Filter by status 0-4 (see the tool description). -1 or omitted returns all statuses.

with_files.description: Include file details (the vendor default is true).

with_participants.description: Include participant details (the vendor default is true).

from.description: Filter by last processing time: start (RFC 3339).

to.description: Filter by last processing time: end (RFC 3339).

tools.name: cloudsign_get_document
tools.title: Get document
tools.description: Get one document with its status, files and participants. GET /documents/{documentID}.

tools.name: cloudsign_list_cabinets
tools.title: List cabinets
tools.description: List the cabinets (folders) of the team. GET /cabinets.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (up to 100 items per page).

tools.name: cloudsign_create_document
tools.title: Create draft document
tools.description: Create a new draft document. Then add files and participants, and send it with cloudsign_send_document. POST /documents.

note.description: Internal note for the sender. Recipients do not see it.

message.description: Message that recipients see with the document.

can_transfer.description: Let recipients forward the document to others.

tools.name: cloudsign_update_document
tools.title: Update document
tools.description: Change the title, note, message or transfer setting of a document. PUT /documents/{documentID}.

note.description: Internal note for the sender. Recipients do not see it.

message.description: Message that recipients see with the document.

can_transfer.description: Let recipients forward the document to others.

tools.name: cloudsign_add_participant
tools.title: Add participant
tools.description: Add a recipient to a document. Wait 2-10 seconds before the next call on the same document. POST /documents/{documentID}/participants.

tools.name: cloudsign_add_file
tools.title: Add file
tools.description: Upload a file (usually PDF) to a document. Send the file bytes base64-encoded in content_base64, up to about 10 MB. Wait 2-10 seconds before the next call on the same document. POST /documents/{documentID}/files.

tools.name: cloudsign_send_document
tools.title: Send document
tools.description: Send a draft document to its recipients, or send a reminder for a document that was already sent. Recipients get an email at once, and this cannot be undone. POST /documents/{documentID}.

tools.name: cloudsign_delete_draft
tools.title: Delete draft document
tools.description: Delete a draft document. Only drafts can be deleted; sent documents cannot. DELETE /documents/{documentID}.
